description:

Once brewed, it will remind you of Dark Chocolate and a hint of caramel. 
  How to brew?  
 1. Take 100 grams of ground coffee and mix it with 1 ltr of cold water in an open container. Cover and let it sit undisturbed for 16-18 hours.  2. Filter the brew in a bottle or jar using a muslin cloth or cold brew filter paper.  3. Store the filtered coffee in the refrigerator. Consume within 7-10 days for optimal freshness.  4. When serving, add ice cubes, milk, and sweetener according to your preference.

name: Krishna Estate
description:
Coffee Variety -  Arabica Beans   Post Harvest Process   - Washed   Roast level   - Medium    Region   - Chikmagalur, Karnataka  
 Krishna Estate, located in the Malnad region of Chikmagalur, at an elevation of 3600 to 3800 ft above sea level. The estate was developed by Krishnappa, the great-grandfather of the current custodians. 
 The coffee is cultivated from Selection-3 and Selection-9 varieties developed at CCRI, Balehonnur, along with the recently planted Chandragiri variety of Arabica. 
 The estate follows traditional growing and processing practices, aiming to minimize the use of residual fungicides by avoiding systemic fungicides and utilizing other preventive measures. Shade is provided by a variety of jungle trees, including Garige, Basri, Byne, Silver Oak, and Jackfruit while intercropping with pepper and areca nut has been introduced over the last two years. 
 The coffee is picked in three stages, with ripe cherries selectively harvested, washed, and sun-dried on the estate’s home patio. Historically, women have played key roles behind the scenes, and it is encouraging to see them now taking leadership positions in the coffee industry. The sisters managing the estate describe their journey back to their roots as thrilling and are committed to contributing to the ecosystem through sustainable, ethically grown, and residue-free coffee

name: Monsooned Malabar Brew Bags, Medium Roast (Set of 5)
description:
Brewed effortlessly in your drip bag, best enjoyed black.  
 
 
 
 
 
 Monsooned Malabar - A Unique Specialty Coffee from India.  The arabica beans from Chikmagalur are transported to Mangalore, a coastal city in India. During the monsoon season, the beans absorb moisture from the coastal winds, causing them to swell and develop a pale yellow color. This process results in some of the most distinctive flavors found in coffee. This unique Indian practice has gained global recognition, and we are delighted to offer it to discerning coffee lovers in India. Ideal for manual extraction methods and is enjoyed best as black coffee. 
 
 
 
 
 
 Each sachet caters to a single-cup serving. 
 
 Travel Friendly 
 Net weight: 55grams (5 sachets x 11g each) 
 
 Brewing  your favorite cup has never been simpler : 
 
 Tear open the bag at the top. 
 
 Gently shake to ensure even distribution and place the hanger securely over the cup. 
 Slowly pour hot water into the bag until it reaches the neck. 
 Refill with more water once the filtration process completes. 
 Cease pouring when the brewed coffee level in the cup reaches midway through the filter. 
 Discard the used filter and serve. 
 Brewing time: under 2 minutes. 
 Total hot water required: 200ml.

name: Rum Barrel Aged Coffee
description:
Coffee Variety  - Arabica Beans    Post-Harvest Process  - Washed    Roast Level  - Medium Roast    Region  - Chikmagalur, Karnataka    
 
 
 
 
 Our Rum Barrel-Aged Coffee begins Its journey with green coffee beans patiently aged in upcycled barrels for four weeks. During this time, the beans naturally absorb the rich, aromatic essence of the barrels, infusing them with deep, complex flavors reminiscent of apple crumble, soaked raisins, and laced with subtle notes of vanilla.  
 Once the beans reach their peak infusion, they are carefully roasted to enhance their unique character, creating a harmonious blend of rum-like undertones with the boldness of perfectly roasted coffee. 
 The entire process is completely natural, leaving no trace of alcohol while delivering an exceptional coffee experience that’s as rich in flavor as it is sustainable. Perfect for those who crave something daringly different in their cup!   Disclaimer "It does not contain alcohol"

name: San Ramon | Gunibyle Estate
description:
Coffee Variety  - Arabica Beans  Post-Harvest Process  - Naturals   Roast Level  - Medium Roast  Region  - Chikmagalur, Karnataka 
 Originally hailing from Costa Rica, the seeds of this plant varietal found their way to Gunibyle estate, where they were carefully nurtured and cultivated. With a gentle roast, this arabica micro-lot shines in various manual brewing methods and even surprises as an espresso. Its flavor profile reveals hints of dark chocolate, raisins, and pomegranate. 
 The San Ramon, a type of Arabica coffee bean, owes its name to the city of San Ramon in Costa Rica, a prominent agricultural hub situated just 27 miles from the Alajuela province in the Northeast. Known for its sweetness, rich aroma, and undertones of dark cocoa, San Ramon beans also boast a delightful citrus acidity.
